# Bento

> Private, open-source Google Drive & Google Photos alternative with no announced storage limit, end-to-end encrypted inside your own free Telegram account, with a JSON-first CLI built for AI agents (OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex).

## What Bento is
- **Category:** Local-first private cloud storage, photo gallery, document organizer, and AI-agent storage CLI.
- **Platforms:** Windows, macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel), Linux (.deb and portable .zip), Android (signed APK, Android 10+), and standalone CLI (`bento`) for Linux, macOS, Windows, VPS, and Raspberry Pi.
- **Price & License:** Free ($0/month), open source under GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (`AGPL-3.0-only`).
- **Encryption:** AES-256-GCM on-device encryption before upload (contents, filenames, folders, dates, photo locations, OCR text, and sync logs). Random 256-bit master key held only on user devices and their recovery kit. Zero Bento storage servers.
- **AI Agent CLI (`bento`):** Single standalone binary with `bento guide` (built-in instructions for AI agents), `--json` structured output on every command, `bento commands --json` machine-readable catalog, `--dry-run` previews, SHA-256 deduplication, and 30-day trash protection. Works seamlessly with OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, and headless servers.
- **Honest limits:** Uses the user's own free Telegram account (MTProto via three private channels created by Bento). Telegram does not announce a total storage limit, but does not guarantee one by contract. Bento is not affiliated with Telegram.
